culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Kikuo Inagaki. He's actually a 60-year-old construction worker and his real name is Kozo Yamazaki. The reason why he wanted to kill the assemblyman was because he made his son take all the blame for his corruption and drove him to suicide.

summary.en: Returning from a mountain hike, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are blocked by a heavy thunderstorm in the waiting room of Ofumoto train station, in a campaign of Tochigi Prefecture, with other people. All trains arriving and departing for Tokyo were suspended until the end of the storm.

suspects: Yuichi Hokari, Kikuo Inagaki, Masako Ueno, Hitoshi Takegami, Carl Morris, and Fune Shimao
